test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate tense:
When I was a child, I ___ to the park every evening.
solution:
The correct answer is '**used to go**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**used to go**" is the correct form to describe a habitual action in the past.
 
• The sentence is referring to an action repeatedly performed in the past ("when I was a child").
 
• **Option 1: "use to go"** is incorrect because "use" does not agree with the past tense.</
